==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{Inqprobe|article name|oldid of the probe revision|number of review (optional)|c=comment (optional)}}</nowiki></code>
<hr />
The article [[Tian Chyler]] was probed, and the revision of the probe was 3405610. The article has not been reviewed in the past.

<code><nowiki>{{Inqprobe|Tian Chyler|3405610}}</nowiki></code>

{{Inqprobe|Tian Chyler|3405610}}
<hr />
The article [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was probed, and the revision of the probe was 3405598. The article had been probed three times in the past, so this is the fourth review.

<code><nowiki>{{Inqprobe|501st Legion|3405598|fourth}}</nowiki></code>

{{Inqprobe|newpage=501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion|3405598|fourth}}
<hr />
A fourth parameter, for comments, can also be used: 

<code><nowiki>{{Inqprobe|501st Legion|3405598|fourth|c=I've kinda fixed this}}</nowiki></code>

{{Inqprobe|newpage=501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion|3405598|fourth|c=I've kinda fixed this}}

[[Category:Wookieepedia Inquisitorius templates|Inqprobe]]</noinclude>
